title: ShieldCare Claim Excess: the Part Deferred for Late Billing
content:
## The deferral schedule

Where the excess on a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan was billed long after the event, part of it is
deferred rather than taken now.

| The delay in billing | The part of the excess deferred |
| --- | --- |
| runs beyond 40 days | 24.00 |
| runs beyond 20 days but no further than 40 | 12.00 |
| every other claim | no part of the excess is deferred |

## Both sides of the two thresholds

A delay of exactly 40 days does not run beyond 40 days, so it falls in the middle band and 12.00 is
deferred; a delay of 41 days runs beyond it and 24.00 is deferred. A delay of exactly 20 days does not
run beyond 20 days, so nothing is deferred; a delay of 21 days reaches the middle band.

## Cases on hypothetical figures

| Days of delay | Part deferred |
| --- | --- |
| 3 | none |
| 20 | none |
| 21 | 12.00 |
| 40 | 12.00 |
| 41 | 24.00 |
| 60 | 24.00 |
